@pcbeingused333 This reviews `15e00f8`. The message change matches #1748. One blocking item.

[P1 blocking] `teamai doctor` changes its exit code when `hooks/list` returns config errors, and that change is not marked as breaking. On main `f327f047`, `teamai doctor --json` exits 1, `ok` is false, and the failed check is "Codex trusts the teamai hooks". On this head the same reply exits 0, `ok` is true, that check is gone, and the note is `could not ask Codex: Codex could not load its config for <home>: invalid transport in mcp_servers.x`. The title has no `!`. The changelog line is under Bug Fixes (`CHANGELOG.md:79`). Breaking Changes starts at line 83. A script that treated doctor exit 1 or `ok: false` as "hooks are not trusted" now succeeds when Codex rejected its config. `teamai pull` stays exit 0 on both builds. A reply with no `errors` still fails the trust check on both.

The CI review (https://github.com/Tencent/teamai-cli/pull/1750#issuecomment-6677336295) says the body has no real built-CLI record. That is true of the body. The run above is that record. We disagree that it stays blocking once the run is in the review. CI run 42165465046 is green at this head.

> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

@pcbeingused333 This re-reviews `b3710e90` against the request changes on `15e00f8`. The blocking item is resolved.

The title is `fix(doctor)!`. The changelog entry is under Breaking Changes (`CHANGELOG.md:84`). The Bug Fixes copy is gone. It says a CI job that read exit 1 now sees 0.

On this head, `teamai doctor --json` still exits 0 with `ok` true. The note is `could not ask Codex: Codex could not load its config for <home>: invalid transport in mcp_servers.x`. The trust check is absent. `teamai init` and `teamai pull` exit 0 and warn with that config error. The code change is only the changelog: `git diff 15e00f8` is `CHANGELOG.md`.

The CI review (https://github.com/Tencent/teamai-cli/pull/1750#issuecomment-6679044344) reports no findings and treats the record naming `15e00f8` as a note. We agree. The built-CLI record in the body matches this run.
